name: Onegrid Meter
title: Onegrid Meter
summary: A connected energy meter built for One Grid Energies, with live voltage and current readings, a weekly usage view and Wi-Fi sync.
lede: Eneon Technologies built a connected energy meter for One Grid Energies. It shows live voltage and current, keeps a weekly record of usage and syncs its readings over Wi-Fi.

thumbnail.alt: An energy meter built by Eneon with a touchscreen showing live voltage and current readings and Weekly and Menu buttons.

overview.title: A connected meter that makes usage visible
paragraphs: Knowing how much power your devices use is the first step to managing it. This meter puts those numbers in front of you, on the device itself.
It displays live voltage and current, shows a weekly view of past usage, and connects over Wi-Fi to keep its readings in sync.

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: The meter measures voltage, current and energy use.

steps.title: Display
steps.text: Live readings appear on the touchscreen, with a weekly view of past use.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: The meter joins Wi-Fi and syncs its readings.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Owners can see how much power their devices use over time.
